newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says ready to help banks restructuring efforts.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says ready to help banks restructuring efforts.

text.p: The Bank of Japan's (BOJ) basic stance in maintaining the stability of Japan's financial system is that it will extend support to any banks which are making serious efforts to restructure themselves but have liquidity problems, BOJ Governor Yasuo Matsushita told a news conference on Thursday.
He said the disposal of problem loans at Japan's financial institutions had been steadily progressing thanks to efforts by the institutions over the past several years.
"We are calling on Japan's financial institutions to dispose of bad assets by making serious restructuring efforts," he said.
"However, if liquidity problems occur in those serious restructuring efforts, we will provide as much support as possible for the stability of Japan's financial system."
